name: Seated Machine Row
description: The seated machine row uses a selectorized or pin-loaded machine where the user sits facing a chest pad and pulls handles toward the torso. The guided movement path removes the need for spinal stabilization, making it accessible for beginners and useful for high-volume hypertrophy training with reduced injury risk. Available in neutral, pronated, and wide-grip handle configurations targeting slightly different back musculature.

execution.starting_position: Adjust the seat height so the handles are at mid-chest level. Sit with the chest against the pad and grip the handles with arms extended.
execution.setup_instructions: Select the appropriate pin-loaded weight. Ensure the chest pad is set so the torso is upright and comfortable.
steps: Step 1: Sit at the machine with the chest on the pad, arms extended toward the handles.
Step 2: Begin from a position of full scapular protraction.
Step 3: Row the handles toward the lower chest, retracting the scapulae and driving the elbows back.
Step 4: Squeeze the mid-back at peak contraction.
Step 5: Return slowly to the start, allowing the shoulder blades to fully protract.
execution.breathing_instructions: Exhale on the row, inhale on the return.
common_mistakes: Not protracting the scapulae at the start of each rep, missing the full ROM
Pulling with the arms rather than initiating with the scapulae
safety_considerations: Adjust seat and pad before adding heavy weight to ensure proper biomechanical alignment
execution.range_of_motion_guidance: Full scapular protraction at the start, full retraction at the end.
coaching_cues: Let your shoulder blades spread apart at the start
Initiate with the elbows, not the hands
Full retraction at the end of every rep
